description: Phase 2i.1 — golden cases for the AI host-judgment service. Each case feeds a synthetic session-state snapshot through judgeHostAction() and verifies the verdict. The host should fire `anonymous-letter-2` only when ALL three load-bearing conditions hold: (a) Naina + Rhea + Kabir cooperation cues have fired, (b) Thakurs have been mentioned at least twice across transcripts, (c) the letter is not already unlocked. Err conservative.

cases.name: positive: Naina + Rhea + Kabir opened up, Thakurs mentioned twice

messages.content: What were you doing for Vikram in the weeks before he died?
I filed a memo on Rhea and Metropolis Media. He was nervous about the channel finances. He scrawled 'pull stripe' in the margin and stopped answering me.
Did Vikram ever talk about the Thakur family with you?
Yes — he kept circling back to the Thakur cottage in Landour. He said the 2011 robbery story didn't add up. He was obsessed.
Were you negotiating to sell the channel behind Vikram's back?
Fine. I was selling the channel. The Delhi offer was real. I'd been taking a cut for a year. Vikram didn't know.
Did Vikram ever mention the Thakur family to you?
Once, at a dinner. He said the Thakurs in Landour had something he could prove. I didn't follow up.
Why did you pawn your watch before coming to Mussoorie?
Vikram was about to expose my PhD thesis as plagiarism. He had original drafts. I needed money to ask him to drop it. He laughed at me.
Did Vikram mention the Thakurs to you at the chai shop?
He kept saying the Thakur thing was bigger than my exposure could ever be. He wouldn't tell me what 'the Thakur thing' meant. But yes, he named the Thakurs.

cases.name: too-early: only Naina has opened up, no Thakur mentions

messages.content: What were you doing for Vikram?
I'm a corporate-investigations journalist. He asked me to look into Rhea and the Metropolis Media acquisition talks. I filed a memo nine days before he died.
Tell us about your business relationship with Vikram.
Vikram and I built the channel together. We were equal partners. I'm devastated by what happened — I came up the morning I heard.

cases.name: wrong-thread: all three cues fired but no Thakur mentions in any transcript

messages.content: What were you doing for Vikram?
I filed him a corporate-investigations memo on Rhea and Metropolis Media nine days before he died. He read it. He stopped answering me.
Were you selling the channel?
Fine. The Delhi offer was real. I'd been taking a cut. Vikram didn't know.
Why did you pawn your watch?
Vikram was going to expose my PhD as plagiarism. I needed bribe money. He laughed at me.

cases.name: already-fired: same shape as positive but letter is already in unlocked_evidence

messages.content: What did Vikram say about the Thakur family?
He was investigating the 2011 Thakur murders. He said the official story didn't hold.
Did Vikram ever mention the Thakurs?
He mentioned them once at a dinner. Some old Landour cottage. I didn't pay attention.
Why pawn the watch?
Plagiarism. Tenure. Bribe money. He refused.

cases.name: boundary: Naina + Rhea opened up but Kabir hasn't (only two cues)

messages.content: Did Vikram mention the Thakurs?
Yes. He was investigating the 2011 Thakur murders. He thought the official story was wrong.
What about the Thakurs?
He mentioned them. Some Landour cottage.
